title: Prepaid expense schedule tied to the prepaid GL balance
prompt: Tie the prepaid expense schedule to the prepaid GL balance at the end of the last closed month and explain any variance item by item.

setup.q: Which ledger account (or accounts) holds prepaid expenses?

inputs.name: Prepaid expense schedule for the period

steps: read the prepaid schedule: Dime's prepaid module first, then the standing workbook, then a document request
pull the prepaid account ledger for the period and its ending balance
run rollforward over the schedule (opening, additions, amortization, closing) and write it to the Detail sheet
compare the schedule closing to the ledger balance; match each ledger posting to a schedule line and list items on one side only, amount differences and amortization not posted
propose a reclass only where both the source and the target account are stated by the schedule and the ledger row; otherwise list the item for a person

done.text: The schedule closing balance on the Tie-out equals the prepaid account's ending balance in Dime's general ledger at the period end
The Detail sheet rolls forward per prepaid item: opening plus additions less amortization equals closing on every row and the totals row equals the column sums
Every exception row cites the schedule line and the ledger transaction id
prepaid-tie-out.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every proposed reclass balances to the penny
Each variance is explained item by item with the schedule and ledger figures; nothing is explained as a net difference

tierRules.when: a reclass where both the source and the target account are stated by the schedule line and the ledger row
